items.stem: 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
items.box:
G: Eric, I like your bag! It’s so cute.
B: Thanks, Yena. I made it from old jeans.
G: Really? That’s amazing!
B: We can make new things from old things. It’s called upcycling.
G: I’d like to try it. What can I do to start upcycling?
B: First, you can find something you don’t need.
G: Well, I have an old skirt at home.
B: Good. Then think about an item you want to make.
G: Oh, I want to make a pencil case.
B: Perfect. And don’t forget to wash the skirt before upcycling.
B: boy, G: girl
choices: Eric bought his bag at a flea market.
Eric made his bag from an old skirt.
Yena wants to make a pencil case from her old skirt.
Yena should buy a new skirt before upcycling.
Eric doesn’t know what upcycling is.
items.explain: old skirt → pencil case.

items.stem: 어법이 맞는 문장은?
choices: Every students should recycle plastic bottles.
Each student use a tumbler at school.
All the children were playing outside.
Every dog love to go for a walk.
items.explain: ① Every student ② uses ④ loves ⑤ is(셀 수 없는 명사).

items.stem: 대화의 흐름상 밑줄 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.box:
G: The air is terrible today.
B: Yeah. The sky looks gray. (A)______________________
G: We can plant more trees.
B: Right. Trees will help clean the air.
G: And don’t forget to ride your bike or walk to nearby places.
choices: What can we do to reduce air pollution?
How often do you plant trees?
Why is the sky gray today?
What do you think of the weather?
Where can we ride a bike?
items.explain: We can plant more trees 는 방법 제안.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
items.box:
ⓐ It is dangerous to run on the road.
ⓑ The colder it gets, the more clothes he wears.
ⓒ It is not easy get up early.
ⓓ The more we laugh, the close we become.
ⓔ My dad advised me ride my bike slowly.
ⓕ She felt someone touching her shoulder.
ⓖ Every house on this street were painted last year.
items.explain: ⓒ to get up ⓓ the closer ⓔ advised me to ride(5형식) ⓖ Every house ~ was.
items.source: 학습지 L5 grammar 2 · L6 grammar 2-A · 26-1 기말 3번 연계

items.box:
Student Survey: Are You a Saver or a Spender?
What do you do with your money? Do you save it or spend it? (A) We asked the following questions to 100 students from our school. Let’s look at the results. (B) Surprisingly, the survey showed that only 15 out of 100 students had a spending plan. (C) The survey also showed what the students spent the most money on. Food was chosen by the largest number of students. (D) Also, 80 percent of 3rd-year students saved money, but only 30 percent of 1st-year students saved money. (E)

items.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: How to make money as a student
The results of a survey on students’ money habits
The best food in the school cafeteria
Why transportation is expensive for teens
Ways for 1st-year students to save money
items.explain: 설문 결과 보고.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 <보기>의 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: Transportation followed food.

items.explain: Food was chosen ~ 바로 뒤.

items.stem: 대화의 밑줄 (A)~(E) 중 윗글과 내용이 일치하지 않는 것은?
items.box:
Semi: (A)<u>The survey was given to 100 students in our school.</u>
Jinho: (B)<u>Only 15 students had a spending plan.</u>
Semi: Right. (C)<u>Most students spent the most money on transportation.</u>
Jinho: (D)<u>Food was chosen by the largest number of students.</u>
Semi: And (E)<u>more 3rd-year students saved money than 1st-year students.</u>
items.explain: 가장 많이 쓴 것은 food.

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 질문은?
items.box:
B: I feel tired these days.
G: How often do you get enough sleep, Sejun?
B: Once a week. I usually stay up late watching videos.
G: It’s important to get eight hours of sleep every night.
B: You’re right. I’ll try to go to bed earlier.
G: Great. Good sleep makes a big difference.
B: boy, G: girl
choices: How does Sejun feel these days?
How often does Sejun get enough sleep?
Why does Sejun stay up late?
What kind of videos does Sejun watch?
How many hours of sleep does the girl say is important?
items.explain: 영상의 종류는 언급되지 않는다.

items.label: [9~10, 서답형 1]
items.box: Hello, I’m Suin from Korea. Every summer, it (A)<u>rains</u> a lot here. Sometimes, we have floods and they are really scary. The situation in Venice must be scary, too. I’ve never (B)<u>been</u> to Venice, but I have (C)<u>saw</u> many beautiful pictures of it. I talked to my friends about the floods in your city. We wanted to help Venice, so we started the 3R campaign. The 3Rs are Recycle, Reuse, and Reduce. Now, many students at my school (D)<u>is doing</u> these three things every day. (E)<u>To do our part for Venice is important.</u> (F)<u>Together, we can make a difference!</u>

items.stem: (A)~(D) 중 어법이 바르지 않은 것의 개수는?
items.explain: (C) have seen(현재완료), (D) many students ~ are doing. 2개.
items.source: L5 본문 Suin · 26-1 기말 현재완료 연계

items.stem: 밑줄 (F)와 가장 관련 있는 속담은?
items.explain: 함께하면 변화를 만들 수 있다 → 협력.

items.stem: 밑줄 (E)를 가주어 It으로 시작하는 문장으로 다시 쓰시오.
items.answer: It is important to do our part for Venice.
items.explain: 긴 to부정사 주어를 뒤로 보내고 가주어 It.

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 순서대로 바르게 배열한 것은?

lines: G: Brian, how about having a picnic tomorrow?
G: Don’t forget to bring reusable forks and spoons.
B: Sure, no problem. See you tomorrow!
(A) Right. What else?
(B) We can use reusable cups.
(C) What can we do to reduce waste at the picnic?

items.explain: 방법 묻기 → 제안 → 다른 것 묻기.

items.stem: (A)~(E) 중 밑줄 친 It의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?

lines: (A) <u>It</u> is important to eat with your family more often.
(B) <u>It</u>’s important to manage your stress during exams.
(C) <u>It</u> rains a lot here every summer.
(D) <u>It</u> is fun to experience a new culture.
(E) <u>It</u> was not easy to solve the puzzle.

items.explain: (C)는 날씨를 나타내는 비인칭 주어, 나머지는 가주어.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 의미상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The fans <u>screamed</u> when their team won the game.
We visited a strawberry <u>farm</u> last weekend.
He <u>recently</u> moved to a new house.
I sold my old bike at the <u>flea market</u>.
The band will <u>increase</u> at the school festival.
items.explain: 밴드는 perform(공연하다).

items.box: Let’s meet Fly High, our school’s cheerleading club. The club started from an idea of one student two years ago. Now, there are 10 girls and 6 boys in the club. Each member (A)( has / have ) a special energy. Do you remember the recent school basketball game? After two quarters, our team was losing by 20 points. During halftime, Fly High came on the court. They performed wonderfully. They flipped in the air and made a human pyramid. Then they shouted, “Never give up!” And guess what? Our team won the game in the end. Jina, the captain of the club, said, “I can flip in the air because I trust my club members. When I see the crowd (B)( cheering / to cheer ) and screaming, I feel proud. Fly High is the best part of my middle school life!” You can watch Fly High (C)( do / to do ) their performance at the school festival next week. (D)________________________

items.stem: Jina가 공중에서 돌 수 있는 이유는?
items.explain: because I trust my club members.

items.stem: (A)~(C)에 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: each + 단수동사 / 지각동사 see·watch + 목적어 + 현재분사·동사원형.

items.stem: 밑줄 (D)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Don’t forget to bring your money diary.
The club will close next week.
Please be quiet in the library.
items.explain: 공연 관람을 권하는 마무리.

items.stem: <보기>의 문장 중 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것의 개수는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - Fly High started two years ago.
- There are 16 members in the club.
- Our team was winning by 20 points after two quarters.
- Fly High performed during halftime.
- Our team lost the game in the end.
- Jina is the captain of Fly High.
- Fly High will perform at the school festival next week.

items.explain: 3·5번째만 불일치. 5개.

items.stem: <보기>의 어떤 빈칸에도 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?

box.title: <보기>
lines: - The water level can ______ after a huge rain.
- We should ______ the use of plastic.
- I always ______ the other side of the paper.
- We can ______ plastic cups and bottles.

items.explain: rise / reduce / reuse / recycle.

items.label: [19~20, 서답형 2~3]
items.box: Hello, friends! My name is Monica, and I live in Venice. Have you heard of Venice? (A)<u>It</u> is a beautiful city on the water in Italy. Venice is famous for its canals and historic buildings. Many tourists come to see (B)<u>them</u> every year. But now, we have a big problem. Last week, the streets were flooded. I couldn’t go to school, and my parents’ bakery had to close. I had to wear tall rain boots all the time. I’m really worried. (C)<u>The warmer the Earth gets, the higher the water in Venice rises.</u> Venice could be underwater soon. (D)<u>My city needs your help!</u> (E)<u>지구를 구하기 위해 우리의 역할을 하는 것은 중요하다.</u>

items.stem: <보기> 중 밑줄 (A), (B)와 지시하는 대상이 바르게 연결된 것을 모두 고른 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ (A) It – Venice
ⓑ (A) It – Italy
ⓒ (B) them – many tourists
ⓓ (B) them – canals and historic buildings
ⓔ (B) them – rain boots

items.explain: It = Venice, them = canals and historic buildings.

items.stem: <보기>의 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 짝이 잘못된 것은?

box.title: <보기>
lines: ⓐ a narrow waterway built by people for boats or to bring water to fields – canal
ⓑ famous or important in history – historic
ⓒ a person who travels to a place for pleasure – tourist
ⓓ to cover an area with a lot of water – flood
ⓔ below the surface of water – planet

items.explain: ⓔ 는 underwater. planet = a large, round object in space.

items.stem: 밑줄 (C)와 같은 형태로, 주어진 두 문장을 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」 한 문장으로 쓰시오. (각 3점)

lines: (1) The weather is cold. + Your house feels warm. →
(2) The price is low. + Many people will buy it. →

items.answer: (1) The colder the weather is, the warmer your house feels. (2) The lower the price is, the more people will buy it.
items.explain: 형용사·부사를 비교급으로 바꾸어 the 뒤에 두고 주어+동사가 따른다.

items.stem: <보기>에서 필요한 단어만 골라 (E)의 해석에 맞게 영어 문장을 완성하시오.

box.title: <보기>
lines: it, is, are, important, importance, to, do, doing, our, part, save, the Earth, for

items.answer: It is important to do our part to save the Earth.
items.explain: 가주어 It + 진주어 to do ~; 목적의 to save.

items.stem: <보기>를 읽고 주어진 주어로 시작하는 문장을 2개 완성하시오. (각 3점)

lines: <보기>
All the members of Fly High have a special energy.
All the members wear the same uniform.

items.answer: (1) Each member has a special energy. (2) Every member wears the same uniform.
items.explain: each/every + 단수명사 + 단수동사.

items.stem: 조건에 맞게 대화의 빈칸을 완성하시오.

lines: <보기> important, it, is, to, keep, your, desk, tidy
G: Your desk is so messy. How often do you clean it?
B: I clean it once a month.

items.answer: It is important to keep your desk tidy.
items.explain: 가주어 It, 진주어 to keep ~.
items.source: L6 Listen and Speak 1-A2 · 학습지 L5 grammar 1

items.stem: 소녀가 소년에게 대기 오염을 줄이기 위해 할 수 있는 일을 묻는 대화문이 되도록 밑줄 (A)에 알맞은 말을 쓸 것. (8단어)

lines: G: Look at the sky! It’s gray.
B: Yeah. Air pollution is a big problem.
B: Start with little things. For example, walk to nearby places.
G: Oh, that’s easy. Anything else?
B: Don’t forget to care for your plants.
B: boy, G: girl

items.answer: What can we do to reduce air pollution
items.explain: What can we do to + 동사원형 ~?

items.stem: 대화를 읽고 조건에 맞게 답하시오. (각 3점)

lines: Hajin: Did you enjoy the sports day, Minho?
Minho: Yes! (A)<u>I saw Jinwoo. He scored the winning goal.</u>
Hajin: That was amazing! (B)<u>I heard all the students. They were cheering for Class 3.</u>
Minho: Me, too. (C)<u>I felt the ground. It was shaking.</u>
Hajin: (D)<u>더 많은 학생들이 응원할수록, 선수들은 더 열심히 경기했다.</u>
Minho: Right. Everyone had a great time!

condition: <조건 1> 밑줄 (A)~(C)의 두 문장을 지각동사를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓸 것.
<조건 2> 밑줄 (D)를 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 …」 구문과 many, students, cheer, hard, players, play를 사용하여 영작할 것. (과거시제)
items.answer: (1) I saw Jinwoo score the winning goal. (2) I heard all the students cheering for Class 3. (3) I felt the ground shaking. (4) The more students cheered, the harder the players played.
items.explain: (1) score / scoring 모두 가능 (2)(3) 진행 중이던 동작은 현재분사 (4) the more + 명사, the harder.
items.source: L6 My Writing · 학습지 L6 grammar 2-C · L5 grammar 2
